findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_mfo, get_reviews, get_market_rules · Public sink: get_mfo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_mfo, get_reviews, get_market_rules · Public sink: get_mfo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
